base.source: EXP-0079 rf_helps (design D8); theta = 0 equals it action for action (tests/test_producer_residual.py)

es.adam_carried: carried from M4 (es_prereg_m4_v1 `es.adam`), not re-tuned for the producer (flagged)
es.estimate: g_j = sum_i (r(+i) - r(-i)) eps_ij / (2 pairs sigma_j)
es.minibatch_source: M4's recorded stream for the optimiser seed (order_es_worlds.minibatch)
es.rank_shaping: order_es.centered_ranks over the 2 * pairs members; disqualified members share the worst rank
es.sigma_source: M4's sigma on its normalised features (es_prereg_m4_v4 `sigma` 0.05)
es.update: Adam ascent with L2 weight decay coupled into the gradient (order_es)

fitness.diagnostics: holding units per cycle and the investment rejection rate per member, generation and read; never in a fitness or reading
fitness.formula: mean over the minibatch of U / B_we; B_we = rf3's units on the world-episode at r0 (the bar)
fitness.source: design D3, supervisor decision 2026-11-05 (units only; notes/2.2.md)

flags: Adam lr 0.02 / weight decay 0.005 carried from M4, not re-tuned
L5 8 episodes per world carried from M4's power rule, not re-derived

guard.margin: c sqrt(2) x pooled within-world-episode SD over rf3's replicates 0..4 (run-down ratio; each consumer's fill), c = 2.0
guard.rule: order_es.disqualifying against rf3: death where rf3 lives; run-down (r_end < x r_start) or a consumer fill < y where rf3 has none, beyond the margin below rf3's own value
guard.source: design D5; M4 v4 formula (EXP-0071: 4.7% self-flags on MWWk)

normaliser.rule: M4's: per non-bias feature, (x - median) / scale clipped to +-5; scale = IQR, else the population std, else 1.0; fitted on rf3's (theta = 0's) raw rows of every producer-cycle of the bar run's training world-episodes
normaliser.source: M4's normaliser (es_prereg_m4_v4 `normaliser`); supervisor decision 2026-11-05 (notes/2.3.md); pinned by the bar run's normaliser.json SHA-256

policy.expansion: the base's triggers or theta_e . psi > 0 (configured, not running, affordable in the planner's spending order)
policy.extra: round(max(0, theta_b . phi_g)) units on top of the planner's want

L1.pass: r0 reproduces the bar's rf3 rows; rf3 equals EXP-0079 on 2 world-episodes; rf3's self-flag rate under the margin <= 0.05

L2.licence: the pilot is licensed by arm S's reading (signal or weak)
L2.same_as_S: theta 0, eps, both minibatches (the recorded probe stream at size 24) and every key; only sigma differs
L2.source: M4 D7 thresholds; EXP-0069's A1-S2 step reading (supervisor decision 2026-11-05: probe at sigma and 2 sigma)

next.flat_at_sigma: the step size becomes a design question; back to the user
next.heterogeneity: heterogeneity was the issue; minibatch 24 suffices; pilot at sigma
next.no_signal: no_signal again: DIAGNOSTICS entry, back to the user

L3.F_tr: the floors rule on that comparison
L3.g_tr: center - rf3 on the monitor set at generation 20, equal weight over the 16 world-episodes, mean over replicates 0 and 1

readings.L4: seed 0 resumed to 40 generations; seed 1 from theta 0 to 40

L5.episodes_source: carried from M4's power-rule outcome (sizing.md §MDE: 8-episode reads); not re-derived for the producer pair (flagged)
L5.reported: candidate vs entity_planner_buyahead_k4 and entity_planner; loss classes (observer on)
L5.success: both seeds' candidate - rf3 > F_val at 12, no extra deaths, run-down / starvation shares <= rf3's
L5.worlds: the loaded (rho > 0.28, not collapse) atlas v2 validation worlds at 12 (deciding) and 42 (reported)

L6.confirmed: candidate beats rf3 + MWW beyond the floor on held-out worlds at 12, not below the floor at 42, no extra deaths, side effects within the margin
L6.ledger: key held-out/m5-producer; pending entry committed before launch

floors.rule: per comparison: max(the atlas-spread floor at the read's counts, own 3 SE); own SE only with >= 2 paired observations on a world (the n = 1 rule); a gain at or below its floor is a tie

stock_heavy.role: reported only, never deciding; to the user
stock_heavy.rule: the selected theta's mean holding units per cycle > 1.5 x rf3's on the read's world-episodes

status: frozen before L2 (design D6); a real probe / train run refuses any other file

worlds.orderer_keys: DrawKey(world, episode, replicate); replicate 0 for bar / members, 0 and 1 for the monitor, 1..4 for the noise floor
